description: Every Apple Business API call, plus offline fleet answers: unassigned devices, AppleCare expiry and Activation Lock.

auth_env_var_specs.name: APPLE_BUSINESS_CLIENT_ID
auth_env_var_specs.description: API account Client ID, e.g. BUSINESSAPI.<uuid>.

auth_env_var_specs.name: APPLE_BUSINESS_PRIVATE_KEY
auth_env_var_specs.description: ES256 private key for the API account: PEM text or a path to the downloaded .pem file.

auth_env_var_specs.name: APPLE_BUSINESS_KEY_ID
auth_env_var_specs.description: Key ID shown for the API account's private key (JWT kid header).

novel_features.name: Device lookup by any identifier
novel_features.description: One row per device with its org record, assigned MDM server, AppleCare and Activation Lock, by serial (live) or by MAC, IMEI, EID or order number (needs sync first).

novel_features.name: Assign devices to an MDM server by name
novel_features.description: Assign or move serials to a device management service by name; with --wait, poll the activity and verify every serial landed.

novel_features.name: Unassign devices from their current MDM server
novel_features.description: Remove serials from whatever device management service they are on now, one activity per server; with --wait, verify each.

novel_features.name: Per-device enrichment fan-out
novel_features.description: Fetch AppleCare coverage, Activation Lock status and the serial-to-server map for every synced device into the local store, resumable.

novel_features.name: AppleCare expiry and coverage-gap report
novel_features.description: Devices whose AppleCare ends within a window (or, with --uncovered, with no active coverage), with optional counts by order, family, server or org. Needs sync and devices enrich --applecare.

novel_features.name: Unassigned devices with root-cause diagnosis
novel_features.description: Org-owned devices not assigned to any MDM server, with days since it joined the org and a flag when no server defaults their product family. Needs sync of devices and mdm_servers.

novel_features.name: Activation Lock exposure report
novel_features.description: Devices currently Activation Locked, user locks by default, with the owner when built-in device management data is synced. Needs devices enrich --activation-lock.

novel_features.name: Audit change digest
novel_features.description: A readable change log over a relative window: one flattened row per event, newest first, plus per-category counts.

novel_features.name: Cross-customer rollup
novel_features.description: One row of counts per customer org: devices, unassigned, AppleCare expiring and uncovered, user-locked, stale MDM servers, sync age. Each org needs sync and devices enrich under its own API account.

novel_features.name: MDM server health
novel_features.description: Each MDM server's status, device count, days since it last connected to Apple and its default product families, flagging stale servers (ACTIVE, owns devices, silent past --stale) and INACTIVE or DELETED servers that still own devices.

novel_features.name: Audit actor rollup
novel_features.description: Who made changes over a relative window: one row per actor (admin user or API account, grouped by actor id) with event counts, non-success outcomes, categories and event types.
